parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of plastic with a printed map surface. It represents the Earth and is mounted on an axis.
parts.Functional_description: The sphere displays the geographical map and can rotate around its tilted axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its axis within the supporting frame.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base structure of the globe, made of wood, providing support and stability to the rotating sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the axis and sphere in place, ensuring smooth rotation and maintaining balance.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
